sections.title: class Person
sections.body:
Constructor - called when creating object

```python
class Person:
    def __init__(self, name, age):
        """Constructor - called when creating object"""
        self.name = name
        self.age = age
        print(f"Person created: {name}")

    def __repr__(self):
        """Developer-friendly representation"""
        return f"Person(name='{self.name}', age={self.age})"

    def __str__(self):
        """User-friendly string"""
        return f"{self.name}, {self.age} years old"

    def __del__(self):
        """Destructor - called when object is deleted"""
        print(f"Person deleted: {self.name}")

p1 = Person("Alice", 30)
print(f"repr: {repr(p1)}")
print(f"str: {str(p1)}")
print(f"print: {p1}")
del p1
print()
```

sections.title: class Student
sections.body:
Equality: ==

```python
class Student:
    def __init__(self, name, grade):
        self.name = name
        self.grade = grade

    def __eq__(self, other):
        """Equality: =="""
        return self.grade == other.grade

    def __ne__(self, other):
        """Not equal: !="""
        return self.grade != other.grade

    def __lt__(self, other):
        """Less than: <"""
        return self.grade < other.grade

    def __le__(self, other):
        """Less than or equal: <="""
        return self.grade <= other.grade

    def __gt__(self, other):
        """Greater than: >"""
        return self.grade > other.grade

    def __ge__(self, other):
        """Greater than or equal: >="""
        return self.grade >= other.grade

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Student('{self.name}', {self.grade})"

alice = Student("Alice", 95)
bob = Student("Bob", 87)
charlie = Student("Charlie", 95)

print(f"alice > bob: {alice > bob}")
print(f"alice == charlie: {alice == charlie}")
print(f"bob <= alice: {bob <= alice}")
print(f"Sorted: {sorted([bob, alice, charlie], key=lambda s: s.grade)}")
print()
```

class Counter
sections.body:
In-place addition: +=

```python
class Counter:
    def __init__(self, value=0):
        self.value = value

    def __iadd__(self, other):
        """In-place addition: +="""
        self.value += other
        return self  # Must return self!

    def __isub__(self, other):
        """In-place subtraction: -="""
        self.value -= other
        return self

    def __imul__(self, other):
        """In-place multiplication: *="""
        self.value *= other
        return self

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Counter({self.value})"

counter = Counter(10)
print(f"Initial: {counter}")
counter += 5
print(f"After += 5: {counter}")
counter -= 3
print(f"After -= 3: {counter}")
counter *= 2
print(f"After *= 2: {counter}")
print()
```

sections.title: class MyList, class Fibonacci
sections.body:
Length: len(obj) Return iterator object (self)

```python
class MyList:
    def __init__(self):
        self._items = []

    def __len__(self):
        """Length: len(obj)"""
        return len(self._items)

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        """Get item: obj[index]"""
        return self._items[index]

    def __setitem__(self, index, value):
        """Set item: obj[index] = value"""
        self._items[index] = value

    def __delitem__(self, index):
        """Delete item: del obj[index]"""
        del self._items[index]

    def __contains__(self, item):
        """Membership: item in obj"""
        return item in self._items

    def append(self, item):
        self._items.append(item)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"MyList({self._items})"

my_list = MyList()
my_list.append(10)
my_list.append(20)
my_list.append(30)

print(f"List: {my_list}")
print(f"Length: {len(my_list)}")
print(f"First item: {my_list[0]}")
print(f"20 in list: {20 in my_list}")
my_list[1] = 25
print(f"After my_list[1] = 25: {my_list}")
del my_list[0]
print(f"After del my_list[0]: {my_list}")
print()

# Example 6: Iterator Protocol
print("Example 6: Iterator Protocol")
print("-" * 50)

class Fibonacci:
    def __init__(self, max_count):
        self.max_count = max_count
        self.count = 0
        self.a, self.b = 0, 1

    def __iter__(self):
        """Return iterator object (self)"""
        return self

    def __next__(self):
        """Get next value"""
        if self.count >= self.max_count:
            raise StopIteration

        result = self.a
        self.a, self.b = self.b, self.a + self.b
        self.count += 1
        return result

print("First 10 Fibonacci numbers:")
for num in Fibonacci(10):
    print(num, end=" ")
print("\n")
```

sections.title: class Timer, class Polynomial
sections.body:
Called when entering 'with' block Create polynomial: a0 + a1*x + a2*x^2 + ...

```python
class Timer:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

    def __enter__(self):
        """Called when entering 'with' block"""
        import time

        self.start_time = time.time()
        print(f"Timer '{self.name}' started")
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
        """Called when exiting 'with' block"""
        import time

        elapsed = time.time() - self.start_time
        print(f"Timer '{self.name}' finished: {elapsed:.4f} seconds")
        return False  # Don't suppress exceptions

with Timer("Operation"):
    # Simulate some work
    total = sum(range(1000000))
    print(f"Sum: {total}")
print()

# Example 8: Callable Objects
print("Example 8: Callable Objects")
print("-" * 50)

class Polynomial:
    def __init__(self, *coefficients):
        """Create polynomial: a0 + a1*x + a2*x^2 + ..."""
        self.coefficients = coefficients

    def __call__(self, x):
        """Evaluate polynomial at x"""
        result = 0
        for i, coef in enumerate(self.coefficients):
            result += coef * (x**i)
        return result

    def __repr__(self):
        terms = []
        for i, coef in enumerate(self.coefficients):
            if coef != 0:
                if i == 0:
                    terms.append(str(coef))
                elif i == 1:
                    terms.append(f"{coef}x")
                else:
                    terms.append(f"{coef}x^{i}")
        return " + ".join(terms)

# p(x) = 2 + 3x + 4x^2
p = Polynomial(2, 3, 4)
print(f"Polynomial: {p}")
print(f"p(0) = {p(0)}")
print(f"p(1) = {p(1)}")
print(f"p(2) = {p(2)}")
print()
```

```python
class BankAccount:
    balance = PositiveNumber("balance")

    def __init__(self, balance):
        self.balance = balance

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"BankAccount(balance={self.balance})"

account = BankAccount(1000)
print(f"Account: {account}")
account.balance = 1500
print(f"After deposit: {account}")
try:
    account.balance = -100
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
print()

# Example 11: Hashing and Equality
print("Example 11: Hashing and Equality")
print("-" * 50)

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def __eq__(self, other):
        """Equality comparison"""
        if not isinstance(other, Point):
            return NotImplemented
        return self.x == other.x and self.y == other.y

    def __hash__(self):
        """Hash for use in sets and dicts"""
        return hash((self.x, self.y))

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Point({self.x}, {self.y})"

p1 = Point(1, 2)
p2 = Point(1, 2)
p3 = Point(3, 4)

print(f"p1 == p2: {p1 == p2}")
print(f"p1 is p2: {p1 is p2}")
print(f"hash(p1) == hash(p2): {hash(p1) == hash(p2)}")

# Can use in sets
points = {p1, p2, p3}
print(f"Set of points: {points}")

# Can use as dict keys
point_names = {p1: "Origin Area", p3: "Far Point"}
print(f"Dict with point keys: {point_names}")
print()
```
